feed.title: Cold Open: guides and editor's notes
feed.subtitle: Every new TV episode of the day, in a few lines.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 28, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Saturday belongs to broadcast TV: only 3 of the 25 new episodes are on streaming. Early risers get Teen Titans Go! on Cartoon Network at 9 AM ET, with "The Night Begins To Shine - Vinyl City Part 1". Fun fact: that song began in 2005 as a generic '80s-style track for a music library, became a joke on the show, then led to a 2017 four-part special and a 2020 five-part sequel.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 27, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Streaming leads today, and the best-rated show on the page is Dexter: Resurrection (9.7), episode 5 on Paramount+. Michael C. Hall returns as Dexter while the hunt for the Five Borough Killer (Dan Stevens) intensifies, and Brian Cox plays the New York Ripper. Uma Thurman returns as Charley. It needs the Premium plan, and new episodes land on Fridays. Tulsa King is on the same service: Stallone's season 4 has ten episodes and ends December 18, so after tonight's seventh only three remain.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 26, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! The big night is the Dancing with the Stars finale on ABC at 8 PM ET. Five couples, three dances each, one Mirrorball Trophy, and it runs a full 180 minutes, so set the DVR if you can't stay up.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 25, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! It's the night before Thanksgiving, and CBS has the best lineup. Survivor (8 PM ET) is down to the final nine, and last week's vote was settled by a coin flip, so nobody is safe. The Amazing Race follows at 9:30 PM ET.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 24, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! The big night is the Dancing with the Stars finale on ABC at 8 PM ET. Five couples, three dances each, one Mirrorball Trophy, and it runs a full 180 minutes, so set the DVR if you can't stay up.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 23, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Monday has 35 new episodes, 15 of them on streaming, and two new series. Dig, a comedy set on a summer archaeological dig in Greece, arrives on Peacock with all ten episodes today. The pilot has a retiring boss, a returning ex and a nervous assistant, so it is a good bet for a binge. Sesame Street also returns on Netflix for season 57 with four 55-minute episodes.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 22, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Sunday is a network night: 29 new episodes, and only 4 on streaming. ESPN opens season 5 of 30 for 30 at 8:30 PM ET, and HBO closes the night at 11 PM ET with the new series Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow. Oobah Butler is known for creating London's #1-rated fake restaurant, and now he goes after the world's biggest industries.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 21, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Saturday is a quiet one: 18 new episodes, and only one of them on streaming. That one is the series premiere of Editorially Speaking on Tubi, a drama-comedy about journalists at a fashion magazine. Tubi is free with ads, so the first episode costs you nothing.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 20, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Friday is light on network drama but busy on streaming: 42 new episodes, 13 of them on streaming, and three premieres. Paramount+ carries the weight. Yellowjackets returns for season 4 with "Hivemind," Dexter: Resurrection has episode 4 (Dexter wonders whether the Code still applies), and MobLand wraps season 2 with its finale.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 19, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Thursday has 44 new episodes, 23 of them on streaming, and four premieres. The big streaming story is The Altruists on Netflix, described as a toxic love story inspired by a real fraud, with all eight episodes listed today. Nelly & Ashanti: We Belong Together is also back on Peacock for season 2, eight half-hour episodes.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 18, 2026
entry.summary: Hi everyone! Wednesday is a busy one: 46 new episodes, 14 of them on streaming, and three series premieres. Sweet Homes (Destination America) starts at 8 PM ET, Small Town Trouble: Texas (Bravo) at 9 PM ET, and Win the Mall is on Netflix all day.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 17, 2026
entry.summary: Hey everyone! If your looking for something good to watch this Tuesday, CBS is basically owning the night with a massive *NCIS* franchise triple-header. While the original *NCIS* (Season 24) puts Nick Torres—played by *That '70s Show* alum Wilmer Valderrama—in a high-stakes undercover getaway car situation, the real must-watch is *NCIS: Origins* (Season 3). Austin Stowell continues to nail the younger, grittier Leroy Jethro Gibbs—a role Mark Harmon made iconic—and tonight's 1993 flashback dives straight into the mystery of what happened to Lala.

entry.title: Editor's note for November 16, 2026
entry.summary: Hey guys! If you're wondering what to check out on TV this Monday, November 16, 2026, let's dive straight into today's lineup. There are 27 new episodes dropping across 23 shows, but honestly, a massive chunk of the heavy hitters—like *FBI* and *CIA*—are packed into a crowded 3:00 AM slot, which feels a bit chaotic for normal prime-time viewing.
